description: Phase 3 resize/maximize smoke budget for the boot-smoke-tests DWM kernel (limine_test_gui.conf embeds assets/dwm/test.toml). test.toml's [startup] autostarts two gui_clients (proving the M3 cross-process isolation invariant — two untrusted clients composited at once) plus gui_terminal + gui_files, and sets `self_test = true`. With self_test on, the compositor drives EVERY live window through the SAME toggle_maximize path a title-bar maximize chip uses — a server-push CONFIGURE — and each client re-imports a work-area-sized buffer across a real process boundary (maximizing all windows, not just runtime-pumped ones, keeps the proof independent of which clients present first). `served two untrusted clients OK` + `desktop ready` prove the desktop came up; `reconfigure ... acked (self-test)` proves the compositor pushed the resize; `gui_terminal/gui_files: reconfigured OK` prove BOTH heavier clients re-negotiated their buffer at the new geometry. Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --config limine_test_gui.conf --markers-file tools/gui_smoke_markers.json --ready-marker 'gui_server: desktop ready'. The GUI kernel never prints [TERM-007], so --ready-marker MUST be overridden as shown.

required.marker: gui_server: served two untrusted clients OK
required.claim: two untrusted gui_clients composited at once (M3 isolation invariant preserved)
compositor reached an interactive, presenting state
compositor pushed a server-initiated CONFIGURE to a runtime window via toggle_maximize
the terminal re-imported a work-area-sized buffer in response to CONFIGURE (protocol resize across a process boundary)
the file manager re-imported a work-area-sized buffer in response to CONFIGURE (protocol resize across a process boundary)

forbidden.why: kernel panic during desktop bring-up or resize re-negotiation
any gui_server self-test failure during bring-up or resize
